## Learning objective

By the end of this short lecture, students can distinguish an estimand, an
identifying assumption, and an estimator.

## Three layers {.section-break}

## Start with the quantity, not the command

1. Define the target population and estimand.
2. State the assumption that identifies it.
3. Choose an estimator and inference procedure compatible with the design.

## A diagnostic tests a threat, not the entire design

::: {.together}
A passing diagnostic is evidence about a named failure mode. It is not proof
that every identifying assumption holds.
:::

## Exit question {.closing-slide .no-stage}

Which layer changes when poor overlap forces the analysis to target a narrower
population?
